text:
alex: FYI AcmeApp filed an escalation — streaming response drops final JSON object when token rotate happens mid-stream. They see valid chunks then connection re-auth, then client reconnects and final 'finish_reason' is missing.

jia: can you paste the raw server logs + client curl repro? is this only on their VPC Dedicated? :thinking:

alex: repro steps from customer below. they repro reliably ~1/3 runs. short thread. curl they used:

alex: ```bash
curl -v -N \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" \
  -H \"Accept: text/event-stream\" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-7b","stream":true,"prompt":"hello"}' \
  https://api.redwood.example/v1/streams
```

alex: then they trigger token rotation (new token issued by our auth service) while the stream is still open. client reconnects using resume headers. After reconnect response body ends without a trailing event and the last JSON object is cut off (no trailing brace). client-side parse fails.

marco: do we have any logs where auth-handoff and stream termination are adjacent? edge-proxy-bot: recorded connection_id=cnx-9f2b, upstream=streamer-12, auth_refresh=true, bytes_sent=12987, last_event_ts=2026-02-18T16:12:03Z

alex: i attached a sanitized log excerpt from their session (below). note the reconnect/resume headers and our 200 response, but client saw incomplete payload.

alex: ```
[streamer-12] 16:11:59 STREAM_SEND chunk size=4096
[streamer-12] 16:12:01 AUTH_REFRESH start token_id=rot-78
[auth-service] 16:12:01 issued new token=rot-78
[streamer-12] 16:12:02 RESUME_HANDOFF header=X-Resume-Offset: 12920
[streamer-12] 16:12:02 RESP status=200 content-type=text/event-stream
[streamer-12] 16:12:02 STREAM_SEND chunk size=67  payload=\"data: {\\\"delta\\\":\\\"...\\\"}\\n\\n\"
[streamer-12] 16:12:02 STREAM_CLOSE graceful=true
```

jia: that looks like server closed the connection right after sending a small chunk. do we have tcp-level pcap or proxy buffers? I suspect a proxy flush or early RST during token swap.

alex: customer sent a packet capture showing last packet missing final bytes. they also reported double billing because their client retried and produced duplicated token counts before dedupe kicked in.

marco: actionable checklist:
- get full proxy/nginx buffering config and timeouts for that route
- check resume header handling code path for off-bytes when auth refresh sets a new flow
- reproduce in staging with auth rotate enabled (i'll spin up a repro harness)

jia: temporary mitigation: add a 250ms grace window on token refresh where we keep old token valid for existing streams (config flag). also return explicit end-sentinel event before closing when we trigger server-side auth handoff.

alex: customer asked for repro steps we can run; marco, can you post the small harness curl + python script that toggles token midstream? then we can validate the mitigation.

marco: here's a lightweight repro script (python):

marco: ```python
# repro-rotate.py (very small)
import requests, time
s = requests.Session()
h = {"Authorization": "Bearer INIT", "Accept": "text/event-stream"}
r = s.post('https://staging.redwood/v1/streams', headers=h, json={"model":"rwd-7b","stream":True}, stream=True)
for i, chunk in enumerate(r.iter_content(chunk_size=None)):
    print('CHUNK', i, repr(chunk[:80]))
    if i == 3:
        # simulate auth rotation on server side by calling auth API
        requests.post('https://staging.redwood/admin/rotate-token', json={"session":"test-123"})
    if i > 10:
        break
```

alex: thanks. i've shared the script with the customer and asked for their pcap + exact resume headers. assigning to @marco to own fix. tagging infra + eng-runtime for visibility. :eyes:

jia: i'll add a monitoring alert for streams with 'incomplete-json' pattern and track any uptick tied to token-rotate events.

alex: customer flagged urgency — production impact for them and a billing complaint. keeping P0 until we confirm mitigation works on staging. will update once we have repro results.

marco: starting a bench repro now, will post logs in this thread. if anyone has quick ideas: maybe our resume-offset math assumes old token context -> ensure KV cache is consistent across auth handoff.

edge-proxy-bot: deploy: streamer-hotfix-2026-02-18 queued to canary

alex: appreciated. i'll loop back to AcmeApp with a temporary workaround (increase client-side parse tolerance + server grace) and escalate billing query to finance.

jia: noted. turning on additional tracing on auth-service for next 24h.

marco: (later) reproduced locally: same symptom, missing trailing '}' about 12 bytes. pushing a small fix to ensure we flush final buffer before close on auth transition.

alex: great—please post patch PR link and ETA for rollback-safe deploy.

marco: PR: https://git.redwood/repo/streamer/pull/1427 - includes tests. rolling to canary in ~15m.

alex: thanks team. will close once customer confirms and finance confirms billing adjustment. :thumbsup:
